event.wren_heart2.0.text: You're just in time. I invented a drink at noon, and by two I'd run out of brave regulars.
event.wren_heart2.0.why: specific hours; the escalation lands on 'regulars'

event.wren_heart2.3.text: Wait. That's a face. Is that the good kind of face? Blink twice for drinkable.
event.wren_heart2.3.why: the panic gets a concrete, funnier ask

event.wren_heart2.2.text: Medium honest. You pass. Take the juice. The day I cook actual food, you're tasting first. That's a threat and a promise.
event.wren_heart2.2.why: repeats the player's assignment back and seeds heart 6

event.wren_heart5.1.text: Truth is, noise is only people, stacked up. I collect people. You're top shelf.
event.wren_heart5.1.why: bar image instead of 'piles'; truest word last

event.wren_heart5.3.text: It's the quiet hours I mind. An empty room has an echo. Eleven seconds. I've timed it.
event.wren_heart5.3.why: a number makes 'I've timed it' literal

event.wren_heart5.2.text: Take a bottle, so the road has company. And come back before four. You've heard why.
event.wren_heart5.2.why: subtext: she won't say 'empty room' twice

event.hall_dance.2.text: [player]. I saved this bottle for a night the hall was full. First glass is yours. Poured before the doors, so nobody could argue.
event.hall_dance.2.why: the bottle was waiting for a full room, her whole want

event.reading_night.3.text: Don't mind me, I'm off duty. I came to hear one story I'm not allowed to improve. It's harder than it sounds.
event.reading_night.3.why: her bit turned inward; she's practicing listening

event.past_the_point.wren.text: I open at noon. That leaves me mornings, and I've started spending them here. The sea starts somewhere else. I'm checking where.
event.past_the_point.wren.why: 'go' made her do something: mornings at the point

event.story_cat.intro.text: Don't move. The cat has chosen your boots. I've bribed it with cream for years, and it's never once chosen mine.
event.story_cat.intro.why: bribery is funnier and more her than tenure

dlg.story.cat.talk.r0.text: Ledger. Tilda will enter it on the slate with the date. The cat now owes her rent.

dlg.story.cat.talk.r1.text: Quench. Juno will stamp it a brass tag by Thursday. By Friday, in my version, it's a crown.
dlg.story.cat.talk.r1.why: owns the exaggeration out loud; cleaner escalation

event.story_cat.after.text: {if choice:cat.ledger}Settled: Ledger. Tilda will be insufferable. By tonight the cat will be doing her books.{else}{if choice:cat.quench}So, Quench. Juno will demand a vote. By tonight the cat will have won it.{else}{if choice:cat.sharp}Then Sharp it is. Piper will write it a song. By tonight it'll be a waltz.{else}A sixth name! Nobody will believe me, so by tonight the cat will have a title and a tragic past.{/if}{/if}{/if}
event.story_cat.after.why: branch openers no longer echo the r-lines; new-name branch escalates further

event.wren_heart4.setup.text: Don't sit yet. Tonight I'm trying something, and I need a witness. Possibly an accomplice. Definitely a crowd.
event.wren_heart4.setup.why: 'a crowd' plants the 'you're the whole crowd' turn

event.wren_heart4.prank.text: Quiet, everybody! One night only: the worst song ever written, performed by its deeply sorry author!

event.wren_heart6.intro.text: Come into the back. I warned you this day would come. I'm cooking. You taste, I stir, nobody hears it was me.

event.wren_heart6.after.text: It goes on the chalkboard Friday. If anyone asks, you cooked and I supervised the spoon.
event.wren_heart6.after.why: tighter; 'supervised the spoon' is the better alibi

dlg.wren.bag.r2.text: ...You didn't tell me what to do. Everyone has advice for the one pouring. You just listened.
dlg.wren.bag.r2.why: ends on 'listened', which heart 10 calls back

event.wren_heart10.intro.text: Chairs up, lamps low. One song, one listener, and I've already picked. The good stool. Yes, you.
event.wren_heart10.intro.why: good-stool callback; privacy without claiming the door is locked

event.wren_heart10.outro.text: {if choice:wren.bag.go}I'm not leaving yet. But the second verse has a map in it, and the map has the sea.{else}{if choice:wren.bag.stay}The chorus was your word. Stay. I sang it twice, in case the first time didn't take.{else}The quiet bar in the middle was yours. You listened once. I owed you some quiet back.{/if}{/if}
event.wren_heart10.outro.why: stay branch names the word; 'quiet bar' works twice

event.wren_friend.intro.text: Friday means bingo. Not numbers, rumors. Sit down, take a card, cross off anything you've heard twice.
event.wren_friend.intro.why: a playable rule instead of an instruction

event.wren_friend.wrap.text: No bingo today. A full card of nonsense, and the best squares were mine. Bring a rumor next Friday. I'll improve it free of charge.
event.wren_friend.wrap.why: the catchphrase becomes an offer; clearer hook

event.wren_birthday.intro.text: It's my birthday. You knew, because I lit a very small flare. Sit, be festive, have a pickle from the good jar.
event.wren_birthday.intro.why: calls back her shipped 'small flare' bark

event.wren_courtship.after.text: {if flag:choice.courtship.wren.yes}Walks and poems, then. I'll be telling everyone a better version of this. In mine, there's a thunderstorm.{else}{if flag:choice.courtship.wren.friends}The best of friends. It's on my chalkboard now, in capital letters.{else}Whenever you like. I'll be on the stage, being patient. It's a new look.{/if}{/if}
event.wren_courtship.after.why: yes branch: the embellisher improving her own best story

event.wren_courtship2.intro.text: You said wait, so I waited. Patiently. Ask anyone. Don't ask Piper. I still like you. More, actually.
event.wren_courtship2.intro.why: Piper as unreliable witness beats 'surprised everyone'

event.wren_courtship2.after.text: {if flag:choice.courtship.wren.yes}Walks and poems, then. Worth the wait. In tonight's retelling, the wait was nine years and heroic.{else}{if flag:choice.courtship.wren.friends}The best of friends. It's on my chalkboard now, in capital letters.{else}Still waiting, then. I'll keep the question behind the bar, next to the bag.{/if}{/if}
event.wren_courtship2.after.why: yes branch now differs from the first ask; embellishes the wait

event.overheard_wren_piper_3.l1.text: Last song tonight, Piper. The room's tired and so am I. Something soft, with no chorus to argue about.

event.overheard_wren_hazel_2.l1.text: Three winters of scribbling at my bar, Hazel. Do I ever get to hear a line?
event.overheard_wren_hazel_2.l1.why: a number instead of 'years'; softer ask

adds.text: No, don't sip it like it owes you money. Commit.
adds.why: lets the tasting breathe; one more turn of her nerves

adds.text: He loses those arguments, by the way. Nobody out-argues a herring.
adds.why: one last joke before the honest turn, her rhythm

threads.wren_heart2: The juice is safe; the day Wren cooks actual food is now a promise with the player's name on it.
threads.wren_heart5: The four o'clock quiet is still there every afternoon, eleven seconds long, and Wren keeps timing it.
threads.hall_dance: Nobody counted the porch, and Wren needs the number before tomorrow's first telling.
threads.story_cat: By tonight the cat's new name will have grown; catch Wren's version at the saloon.
threads.wren_heart4: The second verse is worse, and Piper hasn't heard about tonight yet.
threads.wren_heart6: Friday the dish goes on the chalkboard with the player's name and no mention of Wren.
threads.wren_heart8: The bag stays packed under the bar; the one story Wren won't improve now has one listener.
threads.wren_heart10: The song is on no chalkboard; whether anyone else ever hears it is Wren's to decide.
threads.wren_friend: Next Friday's card wants the player's own rumor, which Wren has publicly promised to improve.
threads.wren_birthday: By spring the toast will be twice as good in the retelling, and Wren wrote none of it.
threads.wren_courtship: Whatever was answered, the village will hear a better version; the true one stays between the two of them.
threads.wren_courtship2: The question lives behind the bar now, next to the bag, for as long as it takes.
threads.wren_partners: The trip to see the sea is now a when, not a whether, and someone must mind the bar.
threads.overheard_tilda_wren_1: Ribbon or bill, something from Tilda's store is headed for the good stool.
threads.overheard_tilda_wren_2: Two versions of the cat-and-windowsill rumor are loose, and both are growing by the day.
threads.overheard_tilda_wren_3: Seven o'clock, the good stool, one cup, and nobody believes the one cup.
threads.overheard_wren_hazel_3: Hazel owes Wren one line aloud, and the corner stool is reserved for it.

notes: wren_heart4 as built has Wren singing her own worst song; the bible says she volunteers the player to introduce Piper. I wrote to the built scene, but flagging the divergence.
event.wren_heart10.intro previously implied a locked door while the saloon is open; rewrite keeps the privacy ('chairs up, lamps low') without the contradiction.

dlg.wren.courtship.* is shared by wren_courtship and wren_courtship2; I deliberately left those nodes unchanged so both scenes stay coherent, and differentiated the two scenes in the .intro/.after keys instead.
Kept the heart-8 bag dialogue almost intact (shipped-adjacent and strong); only r2 changed so 'listened' lands last, which heart 10's listen branch calls back.
story_cat.after branch openers no longer repeat the first word of the preceding r-line (Ledger/Ledger, Quench/Quench, Sharp/Sharp).
